map.RAG 召回率计算器，输入相关文档数与检索命中数求召回率，评估检索增强生成的检索: The RAG recall calculator takes the number of relevant documents and the number of retrieval hits to compute the recall rate, evaluating retrieval coverage quality for retrieval-augmented generation.
map.召回率 = 检索到的相关文档数 / 相关文档总数 × 100%；精确率 = 检索: Recall = relevant documents retrieved / total relevant documents x 100%; precision = relevant documents retrieved / total documents retrieved x 100%; F1 = 2*P*R/(P + R); hit rate = 100% if at least one relevant document is retrieved, otherwise 0
map.RAG 的检索质量直接决定生成上限：召回率不足会漏掉关键证据导致幻觉，精确率不足: Retrieval quality in RAG directly sets the generation ceiling: poor recall misses key evidence and causes hallucinations, while poor precision stuffs noise into the context and dilutes attention. Hit rate (a special case of Recall@k) is often used for a quick check of whether top-k is enough.
map.填写「相关文档总数」。: Enter the "total number of relevant documents".
map.填写「检索返回数」。: Enter the "number of documents returned by retrieval".
map.填写「检索中相关文档数」。: Enter the "relevant documents in the collection".
map.召回率=检索命中的相关文档数/相关文档总数，衡量检索覆盖质量。: Recall = relevant documents hit in retrieval / total relevant documents, measuring retrieval coverage quality.
map.RAG 先召回再生成，召回不足会直接限制答案上限(garbage in, gar: RAG retrieves first and generates later, so weak retrieval directly caps the answer (garbage in, garbage out).
map.常用向量检索+关键词混合召回提升覆盖率，再重排 top-k。: Combine vector search with keyword retrieval for broader coverage, then rerank the top-k.
map.：知识库某问题共有 10 篇相关文档，检索返回 top-20 中命中 8 篇 →: A knowledge base question has 10 relevant documents in total, and retrieval returns top-20 with 8 hits -> recall = 80%. With only 3 hits, generation will very likely miss key points, so recall must be expanded or chunking improved.
map.召回率高就够了吗？: Is a High Recall Rate Enough?
map.不够。召回高只保证'找得全'，还需重排把最相关置顶、控制噪声，否则无关文档挤占上: Not enough. High recall only guarantees finding everything; you also need reranking to put the most relevant on top and to control noise, otherwise irrelevant documents crowd the context and interfere with generation.
map.怎么提升 RAG 召回？: How Do I Improve RAG Recall?
map.优化文档切分粒度、用混合检索(向量+BM25)、加元数据过滤与重排；并定期用标准: Tune the document chunking granularity, use hybrid retrieval (vector plus BM25), add metadata filters and reranking, and regularly test recall with a standard question set to guide iteration.
